title: Children on Swings, Elmwood Park Playground - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 719 On the swings at Elmwood Park
description: A delightful mid-century deckle-edged snapshot showing young children enjoying an afternoon on wooden plank swings suspended by ropes in Elmwood Park. The dappled sunlight filters through lush tree foliage onto the dirt ground. The children are dressed in classic late 1940s to early 1950s summer attire, including rompers, sunsuits, and sturdy white shoes with socks. Municipal parks like Elmwood Park served as focal points for American neighborhood recreation and post-war family life.
